title: Residue kernel detected by fixing an ind-etale local algebra with separably closed residue
statement:
Let $H$ be a commutative local ring with residue field $\kappa$, let $R$ be a local ind-etale $H$-algebra [def-weil-pbc-ind-etale-algebra] with residue field a chosen separable closure $\kappa_s/\kappa$ [def-pd-separable-closure], and let $T$ be a henselian local $H$-algebra [def-weil-pbc-henselian-terminology] with residue field $E$ algebraic over $\kappa$. Assume the structural maps from $H$ are local, and let $i:R\hookrightarrow T$ be an injective local $H$-map inducing a $\kappa$-embedding $j:\kappa_s\hookrightarrow E$. Let $\Gamma$ be any group acting on $T$ by $H$-algebra automorphisms. Then $E/j(\kappa_s)$ is purely inseparable: in characteristic $p>0$ every $x\in E$ has $x^{p^n}\in j(\kappa_s)$ for some $n\geq0$, and in characteristic zero $E=j(\kappa_s)$. Every induced residue automorphism preserves $j(\kappa_s)$, so restriction defines a homomorphism $r:\Gamma\to\operatorname{Gal}(\kappa_s/\kappa)$. For every $\gamma\in\Gamma$ the following are equivalent:
$$ r(\gamma)=1\quad\Longleftrightarrow\quad\gamma|_E=1\quad\Longleftrightarrow\quad\gamma(i(x))=i(x)\ \text{for all }x\in R. $$
Here the residue action is obtained by reducing the given action on $T$.

proof.text: Write $\pi:T\to E=T/\mathfrak m_T$. Every automorphism $\gamma$ preserves $\mathfrak m_T$: it preserves units and nonunits, and the latter form the maximal ideal. Thus $\bar\gamma(\pi(t))=\pi(\gamma(t))$ is a well-defined field automorphism. Since $\gamma$ fixes $H$ and $H\to T$ is local, $\bar\gamma$ fixes $\kappa$. On representatives, $\overline{\gamma\delta}=\bar\gamma\bar\delta$ and $\overline{1}=1$.

source.place: Tag 0BSW, lemma-identify-inertia, residue action; quotient construction written out

proof.text: Apply [lem-weil-pbc-separable-first-purely-inseparable] to the algebraic extension $E/\kappa$, and denote its separable subfield by $E_s$. We claim $E_s=j(\kappa_s)$. The inclusion $j(\kappa_s)\subseteq E_s$ follows because the chosen closure is separable algebraic by [def-pd-separable-closure]. Conversely, for $a\in E_s$, its minimal polynomial $P\in\kappa[X]$ is separable, as defined in [def-weil-pbc-separable-algebraic-extension]. A Bezout identity for $P,P'$ remains an identity over $\kappa_s$, so $P$ stays separable there. By the splitting formulation [def-kun-separably-closed], it is a product of linear factors over $\kappa_s$. Evaluating those factors at $a$ inside the field $E$ forces $a=j(b)$ for a root $b\in\kappa_s$. Therefore $E_s=j(\kappa_s)$. The cited separable-first theorem now gives exactly the asserted $p$-power condition, or $E=j(\kappa_s)$ in characteristic zero.

source.place: Tag 030K, lemma-separable-first, statement and proof; identification using the definition of separable closure

proof.text: For $a\in E_s$, a separable polynomial over $\kappa$ vanishing at $a$ also vanishes at $\bar\gamma(a)$, because $\bar\gamma$ fixes its coefficients. Hence $\bar\gamma(E_s)\subseteq E_s$; applying this to $\gamma^{-1}$ gives equality. With $E_s=j(\kappa_s)$ from step 2, set $r(\gamma)=j^{-1}\bar\gamma j$. It is a $\kappa$-automorphism of $\kappa_s$, so belongs to $\operatorname{Gal}(\kappa_s/\kappa)$, the group of all such automorphisms. Cancelling $jj^{-1}$ in the composite gives $r(\gamma\delta)=r(\gamma)r(\delta)$, and $r(1)=1$.

source.place: Tag 0BSW, lemma-identify-inertia, residue restriction; elementary coefficient calculation

proof.text: If $r(\gamma)=1$, then $\bar\gamma$ fixes $j(\kappa_s)$ pointwise. In characteristic $p>0$, for $a\in E$ choose $n$ from step 2. Then $(\bar\gamma(a)-a)^{p^n}=\bar\gamma(a^{p^n})-a^{p^n}=0$. A field has no nonzero nilpotents, so $\bar\gamma(a)=a$. In characteristic zero, step 2 already gives $E=j(\kappa_s)$. The reverse implication is restriction. This proves $r(\gamma)=1\Longleftrightarrow\bar\gamma=1$.

source.place: Tag 09HE, definition-purely-inseparable; elementary uniqueness of a purely inseparable root

proof.text: Suppose $r(\gamma)=1$. Apply the uniqueness assertion of [lem-weil-pbc-map-into-henselian-colimit] with its base ring $H$, source algebra $R$, target $T$, primes $\mathfrak p=\mathfrak m_H$, $\mathfrak q=\mathfrak m_R$, and residue map $\tau=j:\kappa_s\to E$. The required filtered etale presentation is precisely [def-weil-pbc-ind-etale-algebra]. The target is henselian by hypothesis. Both $i$ and $\gamma\circ i$ are $H$-algebra maps with inverse image of $\mathfrak m_T$ equal to $\mathfrak m_R$, since $i$ is local and $\gamma$ preserves $\mathfrak m_T$; the structural maps are local, so these primes lie over $\mathfrak m_H$. Their residue maps are respectively $j$ and $\bar\gamma\circ j=j$. The cited uniqueness gives $\gamma\circ i=i$, as required.

source.place: Tag 08HR, lemma-map-into-henselian-colimit, uniqueness with prescribed prime and residue embedding

proof.text: Conversely, assume $\gamma(i(x))=i(x)$ for every $x\in R$. For $b\in\kappa_s=R/\mathfrak m_R$, choose a representative $x\in R$. Then $\bar\gamma(j(b))=\pi(\gamma(i(x)))=\pi(i(x))=j(b)$. Thus $r(\gamma)=1$. Together with steps 4 and 5 this proves all three conditions equivalent.
